source_summary: GIVEN 实体 TravelOrder 的动作 create_order 可执行，accept=[tenant_id, host_shop_id, hotel_offer_id, flight_offer_id, vacation_offer_id, train_offer_id, order_no, product_type, customer_id, contact_name, contact_phone, traveler_count, total_amount, points_to_use, points_deduction_amount, currency, ticket_passenger_infos, seat_selection_snapshot]，args=[无显式参数] / WHEN 执行动作 create_order / THEN 输入应满足校验规则，状态变更与副作用应生效，应符合工作流步骤约束
